🧠 Crypto News Brief: Crypto is quietly outperforming: bitcoin pushed toward $78K while AI-safety jitters knocked tech stocks lower. All eyes now shift to Tuesday's CLARITY Act cloture vote and an expected Fed rate hike. 📈 Bitcoin bucks the tech selloff as AI safety fears hit stocks Bitcoin climbed toward $78,000, rising roughly 1.9% since midnight UTC even as Nasdaq 100 futures fell about 1.65% following high-profile calls to slow frontier AI development. Crude oil added almost 4% after a Saudi pipeline closure, leaving crypto as one of the few risk assets in the green. Read full story → ⚖️ CLARITY Act hangs in limbo as the Senate returns The market-structure bill faces a procedural cloture vote expected September 15, and the outcome is genuinely uncertain — the motion needs 60 votes, with ethics provisions, illicit-finance rules and stablecoin yield still unresolved. Prediction markets have lifted 2026 passage odds to roughly 30% from 12% earlier this month. More details → 🏦 Fed, BOE and BOJ decisions make this the week's biggest macro risk Three major central banks deliver rate decisions this week, with the Fed due September 16 and markets now pricing an increase at about 86.5% odds, up sharply from Friday. Goldman Sachs was the last big bank to drop its no-hike call, putting tighter policy squarely in the path of crypto risk appetite. Read more → 🔓 Revolut breach escalates as attackers begin publishing stolen files After a fraudulent request sent from a genuine government email domain cleared Revolut's checks, the threat actors have started leaking customer passports, verification selfies and full bitcoin transaction histories, threatening daily dumps until they are paid. The ransom claims and named victims remain unverified, but the case is a warning about KYC honeypots and lawful-request channels. See details → 💸 Bitcoin ETFs shed $463M while Ether funds pull in $197M US spot bitcoin ETFs snapped their strongest three-week inflow run of 2026 with $463 million of net outflows, led by ARKB, GBTC and IBIT, including a $282.7 million single-day exit on Thursday. Ether products went the other way, adding $196.9 million on the strength of BlackRock's fund — rotation rather than an exit. 79084.subject: 🤯 Surprise last minute effort to pass CLARITY Act
79084.body:
Today’s newsletter is brought to you by **[Choose Rich Live](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**[!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)

Our very own Nick O’Neill is has launched a new stream covering crypto, finance, AI, tech, and the stories shaping the internet economy.

If you already follow Nick, you know what to expect: sharp takes, market chaos, founder brain, and the occasional banger you’ll see clipped on the timeline five minutes later.

Episodes will be streaming live on YouTube, so make sure you’re subscribed to catch the next one as it happens.

**[Subscribe to Choose Rich Live!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**

———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $77,725 (1.3%) | **ETH** $2,507 (1.1%) | **SOL** $101 (1.6%)

* Senate Republicans release a [revised CLARITY Act draft](https://x.com/EleanorTerrett/status/2099317875202756650) with 126 Democrat-requested changes including a stablecoin circuit breaker ahead of Tuesday’s vote — Trump agrees to [ethics restrictions](https://x.com/CoinDesk/status/2099429197034766830) covering himself, elected officials and judges

* Bernstein says positive surprise with CLARITY Act is [not priced in](https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2099419503398715677)

* Saudi pipeline outage puts 4% of global oil supply [at risk](https://x.com/Kalshi/status/2099432969589096577) within days

* Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan now expect a[ Fed hike](https://x.com/WhaleInsider/status/2099424386230944008) this week — Polymarket prices an 80% chance of a [25bp hike](https://polymarket.com/event/fed-decision-in-september-762) Wednesday

* Strategy buys back [$139M of STRC](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2099469485518565636?s=20), doesn’t purchase BTC

* US equity funds recorded [largest outflow](https://x.com/Barchart/status/2099401494155940025) since January

* Revolut is being extorted by hackers after their customers’ [KYC data gets leaked](https://x.com/solidintel_x/status/2099413786608222654)

* Nike falls to its[ most oversold ](https://x.com/Barchart/status/2099395664018809259)monthly reading on record

* Anthropic signs a [$13.7B six-year compute deal ](https://x.com/amir/status/2099305196296028462)with Trump-linked RUM Group

* Fake World Assets turns on [personal pools ](https://x.com/Rhynotic/status/2099196827824542092)for beta users this week and adds a new Punk to the v2 lister

———————————————————————————


———
